record_type_quote: Here we report two attempts to directly replicate experiments from Bargh et al. [ 27 ].

targets.authors: Bargh JA, Gollwitzer PM, Lee-Chai A, Barndollar K, Trötschel R
targets.title: The automated will: Nonconscious activation and pursuit of behavioral goals.
targets.evidence_quote: Again, the basic finding we sought to replicate was better performance on the word search task for participants assigned to the high-performance-goal priming condition, as reported in Experiments 1 and 3 of Bargh et al. [ 27 ].
targets.outcome_quote: The present work included two direct attempts to replicate the "high-performance-goal priming effect" reported by Bargh et al. [ 27 ]. Neither experiment confirmed the original results.

reasoning: Both new-sample direct experiments failed to confirm the priming effect. The initial introduction calls these the first two experiments, but detailed descriptions and statistical discussion explicitly identify original Experiments 1 and 3.
